statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPSubnet)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPVpc)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP Subnets that no longer exist and detach them from all previously connected nodes. Network interfaces, their access configs and their PART_OF_SUBNET edges belong to the instance's project and are cleaned by gcp_compute_instance_cleanup.json: the subnet sync runs before the instance sync, and a Shared VPC host project's subnets carry other projects' NICs.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPSubnet)<-[r:RESOURCE]-(:GCPVpc)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP VPC-to-Subnet relationships that are out of date.
